versions.description_html:
Learn PowerShell for Microsoft 365. Discover modules, cmdlets, pipelines, and safe scripting habits to automate admin tasks without the fear.

An hour of clicking in Microsoft 365 does the job of one typed line. That typed line is PowerShell, and it's the difference between doing a task once and doing it a hundred times.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What PowerShell Actually Is
  • Why Admins Reach For It
  • The Modules: Graph PowerShell and Exchange Online
  • Connecting and Signing In
  • Cmdlets and the Pipeline
  • Safe Scripting Habits
  • Common Tasks You Can Automate
  • Where to Start as a Beginner
  • Recap and One Open Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • PowerShell Automation for Azure and Microsoft 365 with Matthew Dowst [MVP]
  • Modern Microsoft 365 Automation Beyond PowerShell Scripts
  • More Developer Practices episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Developer Practices: the most-listened episodes
